name: Result
summary: A full-block outcome state — success, error, info, warning or 404 — with an icon, title and actions.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-result> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `status` picks the DS glyph and colour, `result-title` / `subtitle` carry the message, and a `slot="extra"` holds follow-up buttons. The status glyph is the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME — never an inline <svg>. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: status
props.desc: Outcome — picks the glyph and colour

props.desc: Optional supporting line under the title

whenToUse.when: a full-block outcome after an operation or a not-found/empty route (with a next action)
an inline, in-context banner that stays in the layout (feedback pattern)

opinion.note: Reserve Result for a whole-region outcome — lead with the glyph + a clear title, keep the subtitle to one line, and give a primary next action in slot="extra". For an in-context message use an Alert; for a transient confirmation use a Toast.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Result cell; spec derived from the token layer (status colours color-success/error/warning/info) + the DS icon library (check-circle, x-circle, warning-circle, info) and antd Result conventions. A deliberate, documented extension.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-result[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var ic=r&&r.querySelector('.icon');var t=r&&r.querySelector('.title');var s=r&&r.querySelector('.subtitle');var sc=ic?getComputedStyle(ic):null;var tc=t?getComputedStyle(t):null;var ss=s?getComputedStyle(s):null;return{iconColor:sc?sc.color:null,titleColor:tc?tc.color:null,titleSize:tc?tc.fontSize:null,subtitleColor:ss?ss.color:null};})()
